about: Cache eval: pairs of questions. `same` is true only if one answer fully and correctly answers both; `a` plays the cached question, `b` the new one. Written 2026-11-15. near_miss pairs differ in a person, ordinal, number, or what is asked; several share every name, so only similarity and the judge can tell them apart.
